inspiration: A terrain flyer built from landblock cells, with blocky textured ground and a grid whose draw radius you can step up or down. The look is open and chunky, readable from height; recreate it with our own terrain.
A minimap you can click to jump the camera to that spot. Simple, readable navigation for a big world.
A plain dark gallery page: black background, thumbnails linking to full-size shots, and a single accent rule. Cheap format for our devlog or screenshot page.

The screenshot names show what a developer wants to show off: a spell bar UI, a frost wall effect, an explosion, a robes clothing set, a mansion interior. These are categories to recreate from scratch.
The site says the aim was an alternate client to the normal Turbine one, not only a viewer. Lesson: a readable HUD with clear spell bars is worth building early.
Look and effect details (colours, shapes, animation) cannot be checked here because no image was opened. Treat the names as a checklist, then build the visuals fresh.

briefs.label: Ice barrier spell (ours)
briefs.why: a freezing wall that blocks the path makes a readable tactical moment; the silhouette does the work.
briefs.keep: a translucent slab with frost edges; shards on impact; a short fade-in
briefs.change: our own shape and colour (not white-blue frost); a crystal or spore wall instead of ice; our own particle timing
briefs.criteria: silhouette at 375 wide: not verified (not viewed); signature behaviour: wall blocks movement; signature sound: none in repo
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Spell bar HUD (ours)
briefs.why: a clear row of spell slots with timers keeps the player in the fight; the bar layout is the idea.
briefs.keep: a fixed row of slots; a cooldown fill on each; a short label per slot
briefs.change: our own frame, icons and colours; a radial or split bar; different slot count
briefs.criteria: silhouette at 375 wide: a single row fits a phone; signature behaviour: cooldown sweep; signature sound: none in repo
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Area blast effect (ours)
briefs.why: a short burst that reads at a glance; the timing and the ring are what sell it.
briefs.keep: a bright core, an expanding ring, a brief shockwave; a fast fade
briefs.change: our own element and palette; a different ring shape; a dust or spark style instead of fire
briefs.criteria: silhouette at 375 wide: a ring burst reads at small size; signature behaviour: expand then fade; signature sound: none in repo
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
